text: On behalf of the Applegrove Community Complex I am submitting the names of the new board of directors which have been submitted to the City but did not make the agenda closing for this meeting. A letter from the Executive Director is attached, and approving them at this meeting will allow the new board to commence work. I wish to thank the outgoing board members for their service and thank the new members for putting their names forward. I look forward to working with them.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following individuals to the Applegrove Community Complex Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending March 31, 2025 and until successors are appointed: - Ann McKechnie - Brian Buchan - Camille Bettonville - Sarah Lasch - Susan Munn - Tammy Rogers
